$comment: Single source of truth for the Trace API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: trace
title: Trace
description: What an agent did, step by step: thoughts, tool calls and results, each with a status icon, how long it took and details you can open.
thumb:
1. Searched the web1.2s
  2. Writing the answer

Trace.description: The ordered list of steps. label names it (default "Agent steps").

status.description: A check, a spinner, a cross or an empty dashed circle.

kind / duration.description: Shown as "Tool call · 1.2s" at the end of the row.

meta.description: Your own text instead of kind and duration.

children.description: Details: the step opens and closes like a Collapsible. Put code in pre.vin-trace__code.

open / defaultOpen.description: With details. Use onOpenChange to hear about changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A thought, two tool calls (one open) and the answer being written.

examples.title: Failed step
examples.description: A tool call that failed, with the error in its details, and a step that hasn't started.

examples.title: Folded away
examples.description: The whole trace inside a Collapsible, as "Worked for 9s", so the reply stays short.

a11y: The steps are an ordered list, so screen readers say how many there are and where each one is.
Each status icon is an image with a name ("Done", "Running", "Failed", "Not started"); colour is never the only signal.
Details use the native <details> element: they open with Enter or Space and screen readers say whether they are expanded. No JavaScript is needed.
The spinner slows down when the reader prefers reduced motion. If you update a trace live, announce the important changes (for example with a StatusMarker) rather than every step.
